analyticalReduction.foldEquation: For H=C(x)-x^2/beta_f^2, an ordinary-root fold satisfies K(x)=x*C'(x)-2*C(x)=0 with C(x)>0 and beta_f=x/sqrt(C(x)).

foldCompletenessProof.self: On every complete positive lobe after the first, K has the sign of g=x*cot(x/2)-2; g'=(sin(x)-x)/(2*sin(x/2)^2)<0, and its endpoint limits have opposite signs. The first lobe has K<0 and begins at the beta_f=1 coincident-self boundary.
foldCompletenessProof.partner: On every complete positive lobe after the first, K=0 is equivalent to g=x*tan(x/2)+2=0; g'=(x+sin(x))/(2*cos(x/2)^2)>0, and its endpoint limits have opposite signs. The first lobe has K<0.
foldCompletenessProof.crossPlus: On every complete positive lobe after the first, K=0 is equivalent to g=x*cot(x/2+pi/4)-2=0; g'=(cos(x)-x)/(2*sin(x/2+pi/4)^2)<0 on those lobes, and its endpoint limits have opposite signs. The first lobe has K<0.
foldCompletenessProof.crossMinus: On every complete positive lobe after the first, K=0 is equivalent to g=x*cot(x/2-pi/4)-2=0; g'=(-cos(x)-x)/(2*sin(x/2-pi/4)^2)<0 on those lobes, and its endpoint limits have opposite signs. The first lobe has K<0.

analyticalReduction.rootCompletenessProof: Each complete post-first lobe therefore has exactly one beta-curve minimum: zero roots below it, one double root at it, and two simple roots above it. Each first lobe is monotone and has one simple root above its boundary threshold. The terminal x=24 boundary equals the largest possible beta_f*delay because all unit-radius site separations are at most 2; directed evaluation excludes a boundary root at beta_f=12.
analyticalReduction.logicalReduction: Complete-phase balance implies A_t(beta_f)=A_n(beta_f)=0 at witness phase phi=0. Excluding their simultaneous zero for every ordinary beta_f is sufficient to reject complete-phase balance.

rootCertification.method: Complete trigonometric lobes with one monotone first branch and two branches around each isolated interior fold; root tubes are endpoint hulls on fold-free beta cells.
rootCertification.fixedCrossRoots: two roots at delay=sqrt(2), each with D_t=1
